summary.intent: Coordinate several parallel subagents on the monokl code-search project: widen the eval corpus (PR #102), diagnose ranking misses, and land ADR 0005 PR 2 (span-based hit ownership), while keeping the user informed of what needs their action.
summary.outcome: PR #102 (wider eval corpus) is open and ready with CI pending. The ranking diagnosis produced a proposal, of which only the full-name bonus is to be adopted after ADR 0005 PR 3. ADR 0005 PR 2 is implemented locally but not yet committed or opened as a PR; the agent was asked to bound per-line match storage first.

repo: Held-out eval sets are pooled by language (Rust 34/36, TS 32/33 questions and 22/22 members) against a 0.9 gate. New report-only repos are marked `report-only` in the rg-compare harness and don't gate.
`just rg-compare` is the ranking regression harness. Baseline scores are identifier 58/59, questions 17/18, members 15/16, Rust fd 22/24, held-out 23/24 and 12/12.
There is no Python lint recipe; scripts can only be checked with py_compile.
`just lint` picks up clippy 0.1.99, which reports 7 pre-existing errors (soundness_tests.rs:842, query/plan.rs, rank/bm25.rs:79, rank/boost.rs:72). The pinned toolchain is 1.98.1.
The only red check on PRs #100, #101 and #102 is Entire Gates, which waits on user approval.
PRs are linked to trails with `entire trail link <n> --branch <b> --base main`, then `gh pr ready`. Changes need a changeset, checked by `just changesets`.
ADR 0005 PR 3 rewrites `name_match_boost` in `rank/boost.rs`, so ranking fixes touching that function must wait for it.

code.finding: The name-match boost loses on four misses. Stop words ("use", "from") are dropped from the query but not from name tokens, and "extension" vs "Ext" never matches. A large block dilutes BM25 for createFormControl. The proposed fix is `name = 1 + 2*m/|Q| + 2*[m==|Q|]`.
`owned_hits` now assigns each match to its innermost containing block by a sweep over spans (ties broken by parent depth), replacing the line-text and equal-range rules.
The sink records per-match byte ranges via `find_iter` on the lossy-decoded line. Matches starting past the 4096-byte cut are dropped, so such a hit owns no block.

workflow: Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user approval, so relay their findings with caveats like "not re-checked".
Sequencing work around a shared hot file (`boost.rs`) avoids merge conflicts between parallel agents.
Read-only diagnosis agents that validate a fix against all eval sets reduce overfitting risk before any code is changed.
Agents should report checks by exit code, and unrun checks (bench, changesets) should be listed explicitly.

friction: Completion notices repeated reports already relayed, so they needed no action.
The origin fetch was blocked for the diagnosis agent, which had to use a local branch copy.
`just lint` could not select the pinned toolchain, so clippy had to be run via the pinned `clippy-driver`.
Many PRs (#97, #100, #101, #102) are blocked on user approval or Entire Gates, so the agent can't progress them.
Parallel agents could not safely start new work because PR 3 and the ranking fix both touch `boost.rs`.
open_items: Finish ADR 0005 PR 2: bound per-line match storage (one range per distinct containing block, with a test on an all-matching 4096-byte line), read the bench results (stress/many must be within 5% of ~670 ms), run `target/compare_outputs.py`, run `just changesets`, write decision-log §41, then commit, push, link trail 361 and mark the PR ready.
Land ADR 0005 PR 3, then the full-name bonus in the name boost, and rerun every eval set.
Possibly revisit the `×0.6` path prior for examples/app directories only if more repos show noise. It is untuned and `app/` is real source in Next.js.
Experiment with keeping stop words when matching name tokens (`useWatch`, `FromRequestParts`) once the boost works on spans.
The user needs to merge or approve #100, #101 and #102, review and merge release PR #97, and enable merge queue requiring only the `CI` check.
The stress/many perf agent is still running and its results are pending.
